Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Zelon Esheth: 32-year-old man, 156 cm (short), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: long narrow face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; prominent bridge, compact mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
